This is the primary text field used by current backend."},"message":{"type":"string","description":"Optional extra message/i18n key field from CommonResult.message. Usually null or omitted for these APIs."},"data":{"type":"array","description":"Displayable public activity list. Hidden/unpublished/out-of-display-window campaigns are filtered out.","items":{"type":"object","required":["campaignId","serverTime","alreadyJoined","participantEligible","joinButtonStatus"],"properties":{"campaignId":{"type":"string","description":"Business campaign id used by detail/join/progress APIs."},"serverTime":{"type":"string","description":"Server time, format yyyy-MM-dd'T'HH:mm:ss."},"campaignName":{"type":"string","description":"Back-office campaign name, fallback/debug display only."},"title":{"type":"string","description":"Localized activity title for current language."},"subtitle":{"type":"string","description":"Localized activity subtitle for current language."},"webBannerUrl":{"type":"string","description":"Web list/detail banner image url."},"appBannerUrl":{"type":"string","description":"App list/detail banner image url."},"startTime":{"type":"string","description":"Participation start time."},"endTime":{"type":"string","description":"Participation end time."},"displayStartTime":{"type":"string","description":"Display start time."},"displayEndTime":{"type":"string","description":"Display end time."},"alreadyJoined":{"type":"boolean","description":"Whether current logged-in user has joined. False for anonymous users."},"rejectReason":{"type":"string","description":"Eligibility reject reason. Examples: NONE, NOT_LOGIN, KYC_NOT_PASSED, NOT_IN_AUDIENCE, NOT_IN_PARTICIPATE_TIME."},"participantConfigType":{"type":"string","description":"Audience type. Values: ALL, NEW_USER, OLD_USER, LIMITED_TAG, LIMITED_USER_TYPE, KYC, REGION_EXCLUDE."},"participantEligible":{"type":"boolean","description":"Whether current user matches the configured audience."},"joinButtonStatus":{"type":"string","description":"List card join button status. Values: HIDDEN, CAN_JOIN, JOINED, LOGIN_REQUIRED, BLOCKED."}}}}}}
